name: instant-api — admin defense-in-depth
description: Access patterns and brute-force probe signal for the admin surface (PR #66+ era). Source: audit_log records with audit_kind = 'admin.access' emitted by the admin allowlist middleware, plus Transaction events on ADMIN_PATH_PREFIX routes. Pairs with the admin-allowlist-breach + admin-probe-404-rate alerts. The 'pg-proxy public-path gate' page tracks the instant-pg-proxy role-gate that bars privileged Postgres roles from pg.instanode.dev (2026-06-03 truehomie-db DROP fix); pairs with pg-proxy-role-gate-disabled + pg-proxy-down alerts.

pages.name: Admin
pages.description: Admin allowlist enforcement + brute-force probe signal

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'api' AND audit_kind = 'admin.access' FACET path_suffix TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service = 'api' AND audit_kind = 'admin.access' FACET user_email SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 25
SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE 'instant-api%' AND request.uri LIKE '/admin/%' AND httpResponseCode LIKE '4%' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'hits', latest(timestamp) AS 'last seen' FROM Log WHERE service = 'api' AND audit_kind = 'admin.access' FACET user_email, path_suffix SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 50

pages.name: pg-proxy public-path gate
pages.description: instant-pg-proxy role-gate (PG_PROXY_DENIED_ROLES) — the durable boundary barring privileged Postgres roles from the public pg.instanode.dev:5432 path. Closes the 2026-06-03 truehomie-db DROP vector. Source: instant-pg-proxy pod stdout (k8s_namespace_name='instant', k8s_label_app='instant-pg-proxy') via the newrelic-logging Fluent Bit DaemonSet. Pairs with pg-proxy-role-gate-disabled + pg-proxy-down alerts.

widgets.title: Role-gate denied_role_count==0 lines (gate DISABLED — must be 0) (3h)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE k8s_namespace_name = 'instant' AND k8s_label_app = 'instant-pg-proxy' AND message LIKE '%pgproxy.role_gate%' AND message LIKE '%"denied_role_count":0%' SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: pg-proxy log volume — liveness (proxy down if flat 0) (3h)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE k8s_namespace_name = 'instant' AND k8s_label_app = 'instant-pg-proxy' TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: Privileged roles rejected at the public gate by user (24h)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE k8s_namespace_name = 'instant' AND k8s_label_app = 'instant-pg-proxy' AND message LIKE '%pgproxy.user_denied_public%' FACET capture(message, r'.*"user":"(?P<u>[^"]+)".*') AS 'role' SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 25

widgets.title: Latest role-gate startup lines (denied_role_count should be 4) (24h)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(message) AS 'role_gate line', latest(timestamp) AS 'at' FROM Log WHERE k8s_namespace_name = 'instant' AND k8s_label_app = 'instant-pg-proxy' AND message LIKE '%pgproxy.role_gate%' FACET k8s_pod_name SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 10

pages.name: customer-db DDL trap
pages.description: Truehomie-db DROP incident (2026-06-03) trap surface: every DROP DATABASE/ROLE/USER/OWNED the postgres-customers pod logs (log_statement='ddl', set 2026-06-03, persists on the PVC) vs the provisioner's sanctioned-drop ledger (event=provisioner.drop — guardedDrop + pool_reaper, provisioner PR #56). Pairs with the customer-db-destructive-ddl.json CRITICAL alert (FROM Log — no Prometheus pipeline in prod).

widgets.title: UNSANCTIONED drop-DDL delta (alert signal; must be <= 0)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE k8s_namespace_name = 'instant-data' AND k8s_label_app = 'postgres-customers' AND (message LIKE '%DROP DATABASE%' OR message LIKE '%DROP ROLE%' OR message LIKE '%DROP USER%' OR message LIKE '%DROP OWNED%')) - 4 * filter(count(*), WHERE service = 'provisioner' AND (event = 'provisioner.drop' OR message LIKE '%"event":"provisioner.drop"%') AND (resource_type = 'RESOURCE_TYPE_POSTGRES' OR message LIKE '%RESOURCE_TYPE_POSTGRES%') AND (backend = 'shared' OR message LIKE '%"backend":"shared"%')) AS 'unsanctioned drop-DDL delta' FROM Log SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: postgres-customers DROP statements vs sanctioned provisioner drops (24h)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE k8s_namespace_name = 'instant-data' AND k8s_label_app = 'postgres-customers' AND (message LIKE '%DROP DATABASE%' OR message LIKE '%DROP ROLE%' OR message LIKE '%DROP USER%' OR message LIKE '%DROP OWNED%')) AS 'pg DROP statements', filter(count(*), WHERE service = 'provisioner' AND (event = 'provisioner.drop' OR message LIKE '%"event":"provisioner.drop"%') AND (resource_type = 'RESOURCE_TYPE_POSTGRES' OR message LIKE '%RESOURCE_TYPE_POSTGRES%') AND (backend = 'shared' OR message LIKE '%"backend":"shared"%')) AS 'sanctioned shared-pg drops' FROM Log TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 24 hours ago

widgets.title: Latest DROP statements on postgres-customers (raw trap lines, 7d)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT timestamp, message FROM Log WHERE k8s_namespace_name = 'instant-data' AND k8s_label_app = 'postgres-customers' AND (message LIKE '%DROP DATABASE%' OR message LIKE '%DROP ROLE%' OR message LIKE '%DROP USER%' OR message LIKE '%DROP OWNED%') SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 50

widgets.title: Sanctioned drops by caller + dropguard REFUSALS (must be 0) (24h)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE service = 'provisioner' AND (event = 'provisioner.drop' OR message LIKE '%"event":"provisioner.drop"%')) AS 'sanctioned drops (all types)', filter(count(*), WHERE service = 'provisioner' AND (event = 'provisioner.drop.refused' OR message LIKE '%"event":"provisioner.drop.refused"%')) AS 'dropguard refusals (bug/attack if > 0)' FROM Log SINCE 24 hours ago
